resources.string: Personal standalone microG services (not for Play Store).
microG Personal v%s is the latest version.
To let you know when a new update is available, microG Personal needs permission to send notifications. Please allow notifications so update alerts can reach you.
Sign in with Google via microG Personal

"This microG Personal build only contains 64-bit (arm64) libraries, but this device is running a 32-bit userspace.
Features that need native Conscrypt/Cronet libraries (account login, TLS, DroidGuard, Maps) will not work properly.
Install the ARMv7 or Universal Personal (-personal) APK instead."
